### Observed differences

- The five activities A14, A15, A20, A21, A22 keep their participation: each occurs in about 15–23 in 100 cases in both windows, and the five shares sum to 100 in 100 in each window, so exactly one of them still runs in every case [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005].
- Their placement changed: before, they sat at about 0.30–0.33 of the case's event sequence, each immediately followed by A23; in the later window they sit at about 0.58–0.61, roughly a quarter of the case length later [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005].
- Their order versus A23 and A24 reversed completely: before, in every case where one of the five co-occurred with A23 or A24 (about 18–23 in 100 per pair) it came first; in the later window A23 and A24 always come first (e.g., A14 preceded A23 in about 22 in 100 cases before and never after, while A23 precedes A14 in about 22 in 100 now) [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008].
- Routing around the five was rewired: before, A42 always exited to one of the five (about 18–23 in 100 each) and each of the five led only to A23, so A42 reached A23 two events later; in the later window A42 leads straight to A23 (one event), and the five now lead to A25 (about 37–68 in 100) or A29 (about 33–63 in 100) [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR008, LAG004].
- A24 and A25 gained detours through the five: before, A24 always went straight to A25 and A25 straight to A29; in the later window about 51 in 100 of A24's outgoing transitions go to one of the five and about 49 in 100 of A25's do, so A24→A25 is immediate in about 49 in 100 cases and one event apart in about 51 (before: always immediate), A25→A29 is immediate in about 51 and one event apart in about 49 (before: always immediate), and A24 reaches A29 three events later in every case (before: two) [DIR006, DIR007, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003].
- A23, A24 and A25, present in every case in both windows, each shifted slightly earlier (mean positions about 0.35→0.31, 0.59→0.55 and 0.62→0.60) [POS006, POS007, POS008].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the five-way choice block (A14, A15, A20, A21, A22 — exactly one of which executes in each case) was relocated from before A23 to the segment between A24 and A29: before, the flow ran A42 → one of the five → A23 → A24 → A25 → A29; in the later window it runs A42 → A23 → A24 → A25 → A29, with the chosen activity inserted between A24 and A25 in about half the cases and between A25 and A29 in the other half. The change is shown directly by four agreeing indicator families — a complete order reversal with A23 and A24 for every block activity, successor rewiring at A42, the five block activities, A24 and A25, step-distance changes on all four observed pairs that match this placement, and a position shift of about 0.26–0.29 of the case length for all five activities. The figures are internally consistent (the 51 in 100 non-direct A24→A25 transitions match the 51 in 100 two-step A24→A25 distances, and likewise 49 in 100 for A25→A29), screening flagged 28 items where about 0.43 would be expected without a change, so chance sampling cannot account for the collection, and the unchanged participation of every involved activity rules out the block becoming optional or mandatory or being replaced [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008].

Limitations: the evidence cannot distinguish a genuine relocation of the same block from the old placement being dropped and an equivalent choice being introduced after A24; it also shows the insertion point (before vs after A25) is not independent of which block activity runs — their A25/A29 splits range from about 37/63 (A15) to about 68/32 (A22) — which the relocation hypothesis alone does not explain [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR008].

Other differences: none; the small earlier shifts of A23, A24 and A25 are consistent with the block no longer preceding them and form part of the pattern above [POS006, POS007, POS008].
